India Criticizes Pakistan's Crackdown on PoK Protests

India's Ministry of External Affairs has criticized Pakistan's handling of protests in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK), where demonstrations over living costs and alleged discrimination have led to over 40 deaths. India cited a Pakistani official's admission that state-trained Mujahideen groups are now challenging the Pakistani state. Security experts suggest Pakistan is rattled by the escalating unrest. J&K leaders have urged India to speak out and called for global intervention.
